items.detail: All Konvy stores are blank for Sep W1–W3 in 店铺销量; only the channel Total row carries real figures. Konvy is excluded from all store-level drilldowns and rankings.

Phuket (KIS) is missing W1 in 店铺销量 (blank cell, not a reported 0) -- excluded from formal WoW ranking for that comparison.
Konvy channel sheet has no September weekly SKU columns (stops at August). SKU coverage: Beautrium, Eveandboy and KIS only; Konvy September SKU data unavailable.

"RED CHAMBER HARUKI Tri-Color Multi-Purpose Highlighter#Snow Song 3.8g+1.9g+1.8g Snow Song" has a blank Category cell on Beautrium; resolved as "高光盘" via the same barcode’s Category on Eveandboy sheet.

"RED CHAMBER HARUKI Multi-Purpose Cream #Jayin C102 1.5g C102Jayin" is sold under 2 barcodes (6975025856014, 6975025857097); merged into one SKU so units are not double counted.
KIS store-sales W2 Total = ฿8,115 vs KIS SKU-sheet W2 Amount sum = ฿8,116 (฿+1 difference). Both are shown as-is; not reconciled by hand.
This review covers September Weeks 1-3 only; the month is not closed. Do not read W1-3 totals as a full-month figure.
All category and SKU findings on this review represent Beautrium + Eveandboy + KIS only, not all 4 channels (Konvy excluded, see coverage note).
SKU销量!AV is an SRP × PCS estimate, not an official sales-value figure. It is not used for any overall/channel/store/category/SKU THB KPI.
The source workbook gives no explicit Sep week start/end dates (unlike August’s "1-2nd Aug" style labels). Only the labels Sep W1 / Sep W2 / Sep W3 are used; no calendar dates are inferred.
The source workbook carries no data-refresh timestamp field of its own. "generated_at" below reflects when this ETL script last ran, not when the underlying sheet data was last entered.
